metadata.provenanceNote: Rolling seven-day publication assembled from approved official cinema sources.

films.descriptionZh: 放映1920s與1960s以來向成人觀眾開放的挑釁動畫選段。
兩名共事者因各自看不見的病症建立起相互扶持的脆弱聯繫。
年輕的孕婦在德州小鎮面對孤立與未來的不確定。
films.descriptionEn: Oli, a very young pregnant woman in small-town Texas, confronts the fallout of an absent teenage father-to-be and the isolation that grows between her and the community as she seeks answers about her future.

films.canonicalTitle: And Your Bird Can Sing preceded by August 8th
films.displayTitle: And Your Bird Can Sing preceded by August 8th
films.descriptionZh: 在函館的夏日中，三位青年在工作、友誼與慾望間漂泊，日常細節流露出深沉的情感。
films.descriptionEn: Set in the port city of Hakodate, three young adults drift through work, friendship, and desire as summer yields to an uncertain future, the film finding profound emotional resonance in ordinary gestures and the rhythms of everyday life.

films.descriptionZh: 通过阿维东的照片与人物，展现影像如何塑造当代文化与偶像。
films.descriptionEn: From world leaders to supermodels, the film follows Richard Avedon’s photographs and influence, showing how his images didn’t just reflect culture but actively shaped the modern, image-driven world.

films.descriptionZh: 一位修女的神祕異象與禁忌情感在修道院內引發衝突與調查。
一位女演員在創作與現實交錯中尋找救贖與真相。
哥譚式華麗改編，德古拉的欲望與復仇在豪華製作中被強烈呈現。
films.descriptionEn: An opulent, baroque take on Stoker’s tale that foregrounds piercing sexual ache and romantic longing, staging lavish gothic imagery and heightened performances as the narrative draws the novel’s erotic and tragic impulses to the surface.

films.descriptionZh: 一位坚定的电视新闻制片人与两位不同风格的男同僚卷入工作与情感的三角纠葛，透视新闻业的人性与机巧。
films.descriptionEn: A romantic triangle set inside a national television news bureau: a driven producer navigates competing men, career ambition, and the moral ambiguities of how television news actually gets made.

films.descriptionZh: 跟随冲浪者寻找隐秘海浪，从加州到澳洲，鱼眼视角与迷幻配乐并进。
films.descriptionEn: Focusing on surfers and a quest for secluded breaks from California to New South Wales, this film celebrates wave‑riding with revolutionary fisheye POV footage and a psychedelic soundtrack, a heady paean to sun, water, and the elements.

films.descriptionZh: 一曲唱片引发回忆，叙述者讲述被妖艳女子毁掉的人生。
films.descriptionEn: A down-on-his-luck pianist recalls a fateful roadside meeting with a femme fatale and the ensuing subjugation that led to a bleak, doom-laden spiral—an absurdist noir born from Hollywood’s Poverty Row.

films.descriptionZh: 一部以愛、衝突與日常場景串接的實驗性劇作。
洛杉磯的孤獨特技車手在黑幫與鄰里之間陷入衝突。
柏林一名少女遭遇意外后，母亲、妹妹與男友陷入如夢魘般的停滞哀伤。
小说家托马斯·曼与女儿在战后德国展开一次充满冲突与反思的公路旅程。
一名導演拍攝續作時，製作接連出狀況，主角關係變得越來越緊張。
films.descriptionEn: After a divisive debut, an up‑and‑coming filmmaker attempts a sophomore feature only to see scenes go awry, actors drop out, and her fraught friendship with the lead actress spiral into increasing toxicity.

films.descriptionZh: 三位年輕人在馬德里二十四小時內圍繞慾望與脆弱男子氣概掙扎。
简约现代家庭中的“游戏”逐渐演变为危险的权力试探，夫妻关系滑向毁灭性的对抗。
films.descriptionEn: A seemingly antiseptic, minimalist marriage unravels when delivered family furniture triggers a series of escalating domestic “games,” shifting power dynamics and leading the couple toward mutually destructive outcomes.

films.descriptionZh: 女律師場上無敵，私下掙扎於育兒、前夫的網路誹謗與混亂情感。
一名自杀未遂者参加时间旅行实验，过往记忆碎片以错乱片段返现。
films.descriptionEn: After an unsuccessful suicide attempt, a man agrees to take part in a time-travel experiment that returns fragments of his past in disordered shards, blending subtle science fiction with a gentle love story to unsettling effect.

films.descriptionZh: 一部描绘宗教性狂热、迷恋与腐化的史诗，范妮莎·雷德格雷与奥利佛·里德主演。
films.descriptionEn: A prescient, fever‑dream epic of religious‑inspired sexual hysteria, obsession, and corruption, presented as Ken Russell’s definitive, uncut vision and starring Vanessa Redgrave and Oliver Reed.

films.descriptionZh: 跨越近一世紀的三段式史詩，三個男人由慾望與遺產相連。
films.descriptionEn: A bold, passionate triptych spanning nearly a century of Spanish history, the film traces three men whose lives are intimately connected through desire, pain, and inheritance, moving between historical periods to examine legacy and longing.

films.descriptionZh: 一名女導演在歐洲各城巡迴間，透過短暫相遇顯現疏離與情感抽離。

films.canonicalTitle: Lorraine O'Grady: Rivers, First Draft Performance
films.displayTitle: Lorraine O'Grady: Rivers, First Draft Performance
films.descriptionZh: 一場1982年於中央公園洛克舉行的現場行為，交織加勒比與新英格蘭的多重敘事。

films.canonicalTitle: Losing Ground | The Ravishing Cinema of Bill Gunn
films.displayTitle: Losing Ground | The Ravishing Cinema of Bill Gunn
films.descriptionZh: 一對夫妻在夏日鄉間面臨愛情、創作與誘惑的分岔路。
从黑暗家庭戏出发，影片化身梦魇般的心理迷宫与身份转换。
films.descriptionEn: Beginning as a dark domestic drama about a troubled saxophonist, the story morphs into an odyssey about identity and desire—a mechanic entwined with a gangster’s woman—unfolding like a whirlpool of subconscious images and nightmare logic.

films.descriptionZh: 在一战前保守英国，莫里斯在剑桥与克里夫相爱，却被秘密与社会压迫撕扯。

films.canonicalTitle: Members Only Preview: All of a Sudden
films.displayTitle: Members Only Preview: All of a Sudden
films.descriptionZh: 養老院主任的生活因與一位罹患絕症的劇場導演相遇而改變。
films.descriptionEn: Marie‑Lou, director of a home for the aged, fights to adopt an innovative care approach called Humanitude until a chance encounter with Mari, an experimental theater director in late‑stage terminal cancer, irrevocably changes her life.

films.descriptionZh: 2002年，密妮和卡麗正準備升上高三，密妮長期活在朋友的光環下。
films.descriptionEn: It’s 2002: best friends Minnie and Callie head into their senior year, with Minnie long living in the protective shadow of a charismatic friend as they confront the pressures of adolescence.

films.descriptionZh: 2002年，密妮与卡莉在高中最后一年面临友情與自我定位的考验。
films.descriptionEn: Set in 2002, two best friends—Minnie and the charismatic Callie—enter their senior year; Minnie lives in Callie’s protective shadow until events begin to test their friendship and each girl's sense of self.

films.descriptionZh: 在特拉维夫屋顶的秘密对话中，以色列人揭露加沙大屠杀的系统设计与运作。
films.descriptionEn: Through secret rooftop conversations in Tel Aviv, Israeli filmmakers and journalists reveal the systems behind the calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza, drawing on the testimony of those who designed and operated them.

films.descriptionZh: 夜色中从特拉维夫楼顶拍摄，记录加沙平民伤亡与目标杀戮背后的系统。
一名资深主播在被告知将被解雇后，在直播中宣布将自杀，引发电视与收视的道德考验。
紐約地鐵與街頭影像與母親書信交織的日記式影像詩。
films.descriptionEn: A diary-like film of New York subway stations and street corners paired with recitations of a mother’s fretful letters, offering a poignant portrait of the city and a touching, troubling meditation on maternal love and urban dislocation.

films.descriptionZh: 五座城市夜間計程車的乘客與司機揭示孤獨與城市疏離。
films.descriptionEn: An anthology set simultaneously in five different taxi rides across the world, where drivers and passengers reveal loneliness, urban anomie, and intimate, oblique moments that cross national borders.

films.descriptionZh: 夜幕下洛杉矶的自由记者世界里，一名野心与道德边界模糊的窃影者崛起。
被囚十五年后重获自由的男人带着狂怒與复仇，展开一段黑暗且令人不安的报复旅程。
films.descriptionEn: After fifteen years imprisoned without explanation, a man is suddenly released and embarks on a brutal, vengeful odyssey that combines visceral set‑pieces, surreal dark humor, and unrelenting intensity.

films.descriptionZh: 漂泊少年闯入长途卡车的高压男性世界。
films.descriptionEn: Veneno, a rebellious drifter, hustles rides and sex at roadside diners until he convinces the taciturn long-haul trucker Muñeco to take him deeper into the hard-edged, hyper-masculine world of trucking.

films.canonicalTitle: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
films.displayTitle: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
films.descriptionZh: 一次在杜克·艾灵顿公寓的聚会，记录哈莱姆文艺复兴人物与文化的鲜活影像。
一名中年男演員在返鄉途中睡著，醒來發現自己回到了年少時代。

films.canonicalTitle: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
films.displayTitle: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
films.descriptionZh: 玛丽安受雇为赫洛伊丝画婚礼肖像，两人在相处中滋生亲密与吸引。
films.descriptionEn: Marianne is hired to paint Héloïse’s wedding portrait, and as the two women orbit one another on a windswept coast, their shared time blossoms into intimacy and attraction, marking Héloïse’s first moments of freedom.

films.descriptionZh: 两对中年夫妻因失业与纪录片拍摄交织出关系纠葛、怨愤與伦理困境。
电视主持人追求创纪录节目，揭开一段媒体歷程與野心。
films.descriptionEn: Centered on To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen, the story follows his effort to make television history, tracing the ambitions and media maneuvers behind a high-stakes broadcast endeavor.

films.descriptionZh: 2006年，电视主持人克里斯·汉森试图创造电视历史。
films.descriptionEn: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history, pursuing a high-stakes media project that centers him as its driving public figure.

films.canonicalTitle: PRIVATE EVENT TODAY IN THEATER & COMMISSARY
films.displayTitle: PRIVATE EVENT TODAY IN THEATER & COMMISSARY

films.descriptionZh: 在中央公园西，怀孕的罗丝玛丽逐步陷入偏执，周遭邻里举止古怪，日常渐变为邪异。
films.descriptionEn: Satanists lurk in Central Park West as Rosemary, a young wife, becomes isolated and paranoid during her first pregnancy, watching the ordinary slip into the profane and wondering why everyone insists she take her daily dose of tansy root.

films.descriptionZh: 十五歲學生沈迷課外活動，與富商爭奪師生情感，引發青春荒謬與憂鬱。
films.descriptionEn: Fifteen-year-old Max Fisher, consumed by extracurricular obsession, courts a teacher while feeling he must compete with a disillusioned industrialist, producing a comic yet melancholic, class-conscious fable of youth.

films.descriptionZh: 在一座險峻海島精神病院，一宗逃犯事件揭露戰後心靈創傷。
小偷展開一連串追贓與混亂冒險，捲入搶劫與麻煩之中。
一名失憶退伍軍人在洛杉磯的夜生活中追尋身份與失落的祕密。
揭示美国军队历史中不为人知的一章。
films.descriptionEn: Uncovers a hidden chapter of American military history, exploring aspects of service and memory that have remained largely untold.

films.descriptionZh: 一位美国畅销书作家在罗马宣传新作时，发现有人以书中恐怖场景复刻谋杀。
films.descriptionEn: An American author promoting a potboiler in Rome finds a murderer reenacting the ghoulish set pieces from his fiction; the film mounts a dizzying return to giallo with striking camera moves and a notorious razor-through-cotton image.

films.descriptionZh: 一名普通上班族渐被改造成钢铁之身，噪音与肉体交织。
films.descriptionEn: An anonymous salaryman begins a nightmarish transformation into a man of steel in a visceral, black-and-white body-horror odyssey driven by twitchy camerawork and a scraping industrial soundscape.

films.canonicalTitle: The Altruists, Episode One + The Imitation Game (2014)
films.displayTitle: The Altruists, Episode One + The Imitation Game (2014)

films.canonicalTitle: The Angel Levine - 35MM | The Ravishing Cinema of Bill Gunn
films.displayTitle: The Angel Levine - 35MM | The Ravishing Cinema of Bill Gunn

films.descriptionZh: 一段痛苦离婚引发与怪异疗法有关的致命暴力连锁。
films.descriptionEn: After a bitter divorce, a man grows suspicious of his ex’s experimental therapy when people on her enemies list are killed by eerie, asexual, dwarfish assassins, unraveling a brutal, nightmarish chain of events.

films.descriptionZh: 一次家族聚会在生日宴上骤然失控，往事指控引爆不可收拾的混乱。
一间东京郊外狭小公寓变成地下说唱的创作工坊，伴随录音台中的节拍诞生新曲。
一部围绕迷恋与腐败展开的史诗式电影，呈现极具感染力的宗教与权力冲突。
films.descriptionEn: An intense, singular epic that stages obsession and corruption against a backdrop of religious and institutional conflict, crafted into a provocative cinematic spectacle.

films.canonicalTitle: The Flavor of Green Tea Over Rice
films.displayTitle: The Flavor of Green Tea Over Rice
films.descriptionZh: 中年夫婦婚姻漸生裂痕，透過小事與沉默表露失望與情感。
films.descriptionEn: A satirical, ultimately touching portrait of a childless, middle-aged couple whose quiet resentments and small deceits expose the unraveling of a marriage and the stillness of Ozu’s world.

films.descriptionZh: 纪录片以混合幽默與情感的方式，追索混凝土作为纽约基石的故事与意义。
films.descriptionEn: John Wilson investigates concrete—the bedrock of New York City—seeking to make a definitive documentary, then adopts a Hallmark formula to broaden appeal, only to see his project and foundations literally and figuratively begin to crumble.

films.descriptionZh: 脱离电视秀后，导演探索以贺卡片式公式来纪录混凝土与日常美学的可能性。
films.descriptionEn: After ending his TV show, a filmmaker attends a workshop on writing Hallmark movies and then tries to apply that formula to a documentary about concrete, searching for a new creative outlet and approach.

films.descriptionZh: 一宗关于烟草业举报与新闻伦理的白领惊心纪实，揭示媒体與企业之间的权力角力。
films.descriptionEn: A white‑collar whistleblowing drama that follows a tobacco research scientist and a determined television producer as corporate interests, media manipulation, and ethical compromises collide.

films.canonicalTitle: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
films.displayTitle: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
films.descriptionZh: 一樁古希臘式的復仇在美國郊區展開，威脅一個醫生的家庭。
films.descriptionEn: A Greek‑tragedy transposed to the American suburbs: a cardiothoracic surgeon opens his home to a fatherless teenager, and a terrible retribution begins that threatens his wife and children.

films.canonicalTitle: The Landlord - 35MM | The Ravishing Cinema of Bill Gunn
films.displayTitle: The Landlord - 35MM | The Ravishing Cinema of Bill Gunn
films.descriptionZh: 一位富家青年買下布魯克林公寓，卻與住戶生活糾結成諷刺喜劇。
一位英國年輕女性在情感與創作間經歷一段具破壞性的戀情。
一支電影劇組在葡萄牙風暴海岸被困，導演須遠赴洛杉磯追尋失蹤的製片人。
一位海岸家的守望者為一名盲畫家之妻所迷戀，陷入毀滅性的激情。
一位电视天气主播为攀登名利筹划谋杀，却发现计划并非如她所愿。
三部黏土動畫短片講述發明家Wallace與智犬Gromit的幽默冒險與機智救援。

films.canonicalTitle: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
films.displayTitle: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
films.descriptionZh: 一名虔诚的杀手在妻逝后踏上保护子女的绝望旅程，同时面对信仰与暴力的冲突。
香港夜色中的小提琴家在街頭徘徊，幻象打亂她的時序記憶。
